purpose: Bounded raw DR24 OID retrieval and Workbench UI smoke testing. This is not a validated astrophysical object catalog or training set.

source_artifacts.role: Candidate cross-match coordinates and object identifiers.
Verifies that each selected OID has a lightcurve row, photometry, and consistent filter metadata; supplies catalog epoch counts.
Independent canonical payload SHA-256 references for the first four OIDs.

identity_policy.spatial_matching_method: The source recovery workflow used a bounded 5-arcsec spatial candidate match.
rules: A BTS external_id is a candidate reference identifier, not independent astrophysical ground truth.
A ZTF objectid identifies a filter/field/quadrant-specific time series. It is not a guaranteed unique astrophysical source ID.
Multiple OIDs listed under one BTS candidate are not merged by this manifest.
Do not use these associations for training labels, model evaluation, cross-OID grouping, or scientific identity claims.
Use the manifest only to select bounded raw OID lookups and display candidate provenance.

usage_status.workbench_smoke_test: Five OIDs/650 epochs passed in run 42232639126. Seven-OID expansion is pending.

limitations: The candidate BTS-to-ZTF spatial associations are not confirmed physical identities.
The 5-arcsec spatial candidate match is not an identity criterion.
The first two candidate groups have g/r OID pairs with small mutual angular separation, but this does not prove the published cross-match or selection method.
The first four payload hashes have independent HATS references. The last three require independent payload probes.
No HMJD conversion, color correction, catflags filtering, QC selection, feature generation, inference, calibration, OOD or anomaly analysis is performed.
